{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute conversion rate by channel and customer_segment
df_grouped = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum']).reset_index()
df_grouped['conversion_rate'] = df_grouped['sum'] / df_grouped['count']

# Pivot to get conversion rates per channel per segment
df_pivot = df_grouped.pivot(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='conversion_rate')

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) per segment
df_pivot['diff'] = df_pivot['email'] - df_pivot['paid_search']

# Compute overall difference as weighted average of segment-specific differences
# Weight by total number of orders in each segment (across both channels)
total_in_segment = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].count()
weighted_diff = (df_pivot['diff'] * total_in_segment).sum() / total_in_segment.sum()

# Output
print(f"Segment-specific conversion rate differences (email - paid_search):\n{df_pivot[['diff']]}\n")
print(f"Overall weighted difference in conversion rates: {weighted_diff}")"}
